subject: Next steps: procurement & security qualification for Acme
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps from today's discovery call — procurement & security items

Alex / Dana — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward a summer procurement decision:

- Summary: Acme is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing chat and internal summarization workloads. Key gating items: SOC 2 report, DPA language, and clarity on purchase method (PO vs card) + marketplace option.
- Attached: draft SOW for initial pilot, Redwood DPA, and our latest SOC 2 report.

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm the procurement path (PO + standard terms / corporate card / AWS Marketplace). If PO, do you need a quote or an invoice template?
2) Let us know any DPA edits up front — we can provision a redline or have Legal join a short session.
3) If there are security questionnaire items we haven't covered, send them over; we can route to Rishi for answers.

Tentative timeline: pilot contract signed by end of July -> pilot start early August. If we can confirm PO path this week, I can escalate to legal for a quick turnaround.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0139

Attachments: Redwood_DPA.pdf; SOC2_Report_2025.pdf; SOW_Draft.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery call — procurement & security items

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the materials. A couple quick clarifications from procurement side:

- We're planning to use a PO for this engagement (preferred). We typically require a standard quote with company billing details + payment terms (Net 30). Can you send a quote and the Redwood vendor form?
- We're evaluating marketplace options (AWS Marketplace) for long-term procurement — is Redwood available there or in process? If marketplace is preferred, procurement has different approval flow and timeline.
- On security: SOC 2 report looks good at a glance. We do have a short security questionnaire (attached) with a few follow-ups about encryption key management and data residency. Can your security/infra team answer?

If we can get a PO-ready quote and answers to the questionnaire by early next week, we can get the PO raised in parallel with legal review of the DPA.

Thanks —
Alex
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Corporation
procurement@acme.com

Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery call — procurement & security items

Alex — great, PO path makes sense. Answers inline: 

- Quote: Attached is a PO-ready quote including billing info and Net 30 terms. If you need alternative payment terms or a vendor form, send it over and I'll get procurement ops to fill it out.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace for our hosted API; Dedicated and Private offerings are available via marketplace for some partners but typically require a partner onboarding step. If you prefer the marketplace route we can loop in our partner team; note that SaaS billing via marketplace may change timing vs direct PO.
- Security questionnaire: Rishi (cc'd) will take the questionnaire — he can provide answers and any supporting artifacts.

Next steps I propose:
1) Acme raises PO in parallel to legal review of DPA redlines.
2) Rishi to respond to the questionnaire and attach any evidence (cert report excerpts).
3) We aim for an executed SOW (pilot) by 07/30 and pilot kickoff 08/03.

Rishi / Dev — can you confirm availability this week to answer the questionnaire and provide a short readout for Acme's security team?

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Quote_07012026.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery call — procurement & security items

Hi Alex / Marissa — thanks for looping me in. Quick notes on the questionnaire and evidence: 

- Encryption KMS: We support customer-managed keys via integrations with KMS/HSM on Dedicated/Private. For hosted API, we offer envelope encryption and are SOC 2-compliant with documented key rotation policies.
- Data residency: Hosted API data can be routed to region-specific clusters (US/EU) depending on contract. For strict residency requirements, Private deployment is recommended.
- Evidence: attaching SOC2_Report_2025.pdf; can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter if needed and excerpts from our control mappings.

I'll complete the questionnaire by EOD today and include references to the supporting docs. Dev (cc) will confirm any technical implementation details if the pilot needs KMS integration.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery call — procurement & security items

Appreciate the quick responses — this is helpful. A few items to close on our side: 

- Please send the PO-ready quote to procurement@acme.com and include Redwood's W-9/Vendor ID.
- DPA: I'll have our legal attach redline and send by Wednesday; if you can confirm turnaround on comments (target: 3 business days) that helps our timeline.
- Questionnaire: once Rishi sends the completed questionnaire and evidence we're good to move forward with PO.

If all aligns, we'll aim to have PO issued by 07/24. Please also add a DocuSign link for the SOW when it's ready.

Thanks —
Alex
